mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_change_logs(user_id, field, field_label, old_value, new_value, source, changed_by) VALUES(#{userId}, #{field}, #{fieldLabel}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{source}, #{changedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.user_id, l.field, l.field_label, l.old_value, l.new_value, l.source, l.changed_by, actor.name AS changed_by_name, l.changed_at FROM user_change_logs l LEFT JOIN users actor ON actor.id = l.changed_by WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.changed_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_change_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId}
